articles.headline: Celtic condemn protest after tennis balls thrown at owner
articles.description: Celtic have condemned the protest which saw tennis balls thrown towards principal shareholder Dermot Desmond during his visit to the Alfred Dunhill Links golf tournament at St Andrews.
